decisions.reason: The chart plugin's frequent releases and close fit with the firm's web map expertise enable ongoing assimilation of feedback, making withdrawal very unlikely.

The mobile map layer control was highlighted on the home page and leverages established mobile GIS components, indicating strong related knowledge and learning, so withdrawal is unlikely.
Mobile field data capture software extends the firm's existing mobile and GIS capabilities, and its dedicated page suggests active market presence and learning potential, supporting a keep decision.
The search extension is close to the firm's existing web map application portfolio, and its own R&D allows the firm to assimilate user feedback and improve, so it is likely to be kept.
